method: Independent recomputation from frozen label/prediction files; no model selection, fitting, or source edits

bootstrap.estimator: equal-weight mean of eight within-stratum paired mean absolute-error differences
bootstrap.resampling: 24 candidate pairs with replacement within each fixed declared stratum; same draws for both models and both comparisons
bootstrap.interpretation: Descriptive conditional formula-level uncertainty for this curated synthetic stress probe. Strata are fixed, not independently sampled real workloads.

v3_structural.difference_definition: comparator absolute error minus MasterRTL absolute error; positive favors MasterRTL

v2_residual_xgb.difference_definition: comparator absolute error minus MasterRTL absolute error; positive favors MasterRTL

limitations: Matched retrained MasterRTL recipe adaptation on isolated iCE40 LUT4 labels, not reproduction of published ASIC scores.
Synthetic formulas are not independent executed workloads; these intervals do not establish superiority on real programs or full processor PPA.
MAPE includes every positive label, including labels of one or two LUT4; zeros are excluded only from MAPE and remain in MAE/RMSLE.
Bootstrap resampling is descriptive and does not correct selection of this convenience stress-test pool or dependence between related graph patterns.

dominant_percentage_error_candidate_anal.rv32_semantics_explanation: Mask selects only bit 31 of in0. Low 32-bit multiplication keeps only bit 0 of masked in1; right shift by 30 puts their AND in output bit 1. Thus result = ((in0 >> 31) & (in1 & 1)) << 1. The model failed to capture a genuine collapsed one-LUT circuit; MAPE additionally magnifies the large absolute error through denominator one.
